personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (with Editorial/Gaming filigree accents)
personality_one_liner: A premium, cinematic post-apocalyptic compendium that feels like an ancient, high-tech survivor's codex.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing on cinematic screens, tight and tabular spacing within the parchment stats panels. Do not use random pixel offsets.

do's: Use heavy glass effect over misty/apocalyptic background photos for Home and Dashboard layers
Use dark tinted glass behind text to ensure readability
Layer glass headers above scrolling content
dont's: Don't use glassmorphism on the parchment (surfaceInverse) info panels, those should remain solid
Don't blur the hero item images

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard highlighting current patch notes, latest news, and quick navigation to categories.

states.loading: Dark misty background with a gold spinning diamond or crosshair.
states.empty: No news available, display 'Awaiting transmission...' text.
states.error: Error fetching news. Display 'Signal Lost' with retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image banner with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Glass-layered cards for latest Patch Notes and News (Steam feed placeholders). Below, a 2-column grid of quick links (Weapons, Armor, Mods, Deviations) utilizing brandTertiary tinted backgrounds.

screens.name: Codex
screens.purpose: Database browser for items featuring search and rarity filters.

states.loading: Skeleton grid over the dark surface.
states.empty: No items match filters. Display 'Database empty'.

screens.layout: Top sticky search bar and a horizontally scrolling row of filter chips (Type, Rarity). The main content is a 2-column grid of item cards. Each card has a subtle border matching its rarity (e.g., rarityLegendary for gold) and a dark glass background. Hero images are clipped neatly inside.

screens.name: ItemDetail
screens.purpose: The 'Legendary Card' view - ornate, detailed specs and lore for a selected weapon or armor.
screens.layout: A scrollable cinematic view. Top: Full-bleed weapon artwork overlaid on a dark misty background with a red/magenta anomaly glow (brandSecondary). The frame has a subtle gold (brandPrimary) ornate border. A gold ribbon below the image spells the rarity (e.g., 'LEGENDARY'). Bottom half: A solid panel using `surfaceInverse` (Parchment beige) with dark `onSurfaceInverse` text. This panel includes a dark serif subtitle, a lore paragraph, an italicized quote, and a highly structured stats table with small icons (ammo type, damage, fire rate) and right-aligned values.

screens.name: Assistant
screens.purpose: AI chat interface for game mechanics, tips, and queries.

states.empty: Initial greeting message from the AI orb.

screens.layout: Chat interface. Top header with 'AI Guide'. Dark surface background with glowing AI orb watermark. User messages in brandTertiary bubbles, AI responses in surfaceSecondary glass bubbles. Bottom sticky input.

screens.name: Guides
screens.purpose: List of game mechanics tutorials with embedded YouTube video links.
screens.layout: Vertical list of large cards. Each card has a video thumbnail with a play icon overlay, title, and a short summary of the tutorial. Using glass cards on top of a dark post-apocalyptic city background.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT THE 'LEGENDARY CARD' EXACTLY AS REQUESTED: On the ItemDetail screen, use a full-bleed hero image of the weapon over a dark background. Below the image, render a gold rarity ribbon banner. Below that, MUST use the `surfaceInverse` (Parchment beige) color for the stats and lore container, with `onSurfaceInverse` (Dark text). Use the `CormorantGaramond` serif font for the weapon title and lore/quote, and `DMSans` for the tabular stats.
Add explicit rarity colors to the theme object and use them for item card borders/ribbons: Common (#9BA0A6), Rare (#4D88D9), Epic (#9A58E8), Legendary (#D6B560).
Ensure Settings functionality (Language toggle CZ/EN) is placed either as a top-right header icon on the Home tab or within the Assistant tab's header, keeping tabs max to 4.
In the Codex screen, use MaterialCommunityIcons for stats (e.g., 'pistol' for ammo type, 'crosshairs' for accuracy, 'chart-line' for stability) to mimic the game's UI.
Use expo-font to load 'CormorantGaramond_500Medium' and 'DMSans_400Regular' or 'DMSans_500Medium'. Do not use heavy font weights.
Mock the 'Steam news' feed and 'Wiki database' data using the provided placeholder images until actual APIs are integrated.
